summary: Project includes a Spin the Wheel feature with a 20-minute cooldown timer. Points earned go to the Virtual Pet, and trophies go to the Total Score.
architectural_notes: Spin the Wheel has a 20-minute cooldown between spins
Spin the Wheel points route to Virtual Pet; trophies route to Total Score
known_issues: Spin the Wheel cooldown timer not enforcing 20-minute wait
Spin the Wheel points not correctly routing to Virtual Pet

existing_features.title: In the Spin the Wheel page (frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx), display a disabled spin button with a countdown timer showing the remaining time (MM:SS) when the user is in cooldown. Re-enable the button automatically once the 20-minute cooldown expires.

In the Spin the Wheel page (frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx), after a spin that yields points, call only the mutation that updates the Virtual Pet with the earned points. Do not call any other reward or score mutation for point outcomes.

new_feature_requests.summary: Spin the Wheel: enforce 20-minute cooldown before next spin
Spin the Wheel: points earned should be added to the Virtual Pet only
Spin the Wheel: trophies earned should go to Total Score only

Enforce a 20-minute cooldown on the Spin the Wheel feature in the backend. After a user spins, record the timestamp of their last spin and prevent another spin until 20 minutes have elapsed. Return the remaining cooldown time to the frontend so it can display a countdown.

When points are won on the Spin the Wheel, add them exclusively to the Virtual Pet's points/experience in the backend (e.g., the VirtualPetHub record). Do not add spin-wheel points to any other score field or reward bucket.
